data.action: 托腮看着蛋糕两眼放光
data.description: 温馨可爱的宿舍小圆桌前，艾雅法拉双手托腮，看着面前刚出炉的草莓奶油小蛋糕两眼放光，羊角在头顶欢快地晃动——「哇！前辈特意为我带了蛋糕吗？因为听力不太好，平时总让前辈费心大声说话……真的太谢谢前辈了！」
data.promptProse: In her Rhodes Island dorm room, Eyjafjalla rests both elbows on a round wooden table and cups her cheeks as she takes in the fresh strawberry shortcake. The sleeves of her cream fleece hoodie gather at her wrists, with rose-colored drawstrings and socks picking up the red of the berries. Two saucers sit on opposite sides of the cake, with the nearer cup at the edge of the frame. Afternoon light comes through the side curtain and catches the steam, leaving enough detail in the background to see the folded plaid blanket at the foot of her bunk.
data.title: 艾雅法拉 · 宿舍茶点
data.animaCaption: Resting both elbows on the round dorm table, she cups her cheeks and gazes eagerly at the fresh strawberry shortcake. Two steaming teacups sit beside the plate as afternoon window light reaches the folded plaid blanket at the foot of her bed.
